name: Mini Umbrella with Case
description: The portable totes umbrellas come with a stylish case that can be carried easily. Folding umbrellas can fit itself everywhere, very lightweight and handy, and take up little space. There are various bright colors for you, making the travel size umbrella an excellent present for your family, friends and colleagues etc,Qty for 1000 and over by sea.
